parsed.name: 光束挡板
parsed.description: 用于束线或实验光路中的插入/移出式挡板设备。该类设备通过外部控制信号执行打开与关闭，并结合进位/退位限位开关判断当前位置；部分变体仅提供状态读取，用于光路联锁显示与通光状态判断。
parsed.description_en: An insertable/removable beamline stopper used in experimental beam paths. It is opened and closed via external control signals, and its position is determined from in/out limit switches; some variants are status-only and are used for lightpath display and transmission-state evaluation.

actions.description: 打开挡板，使光路处于放行状态。
actions.description_en: Open the stopper to allow the beam path to pass.

actions.description: 关闭挡板，将挡板插入光路以阻断通光。
actions.description_en: Close the stopper, inserting it into the beam path to block transmission.

actions.description: 检查输入值是否对应有效的挡板状态或命令值。
actions.description_en: Check whether an input value corresponds to a valid stopper state or command value.

actions.description: 根据进位和退位限位信号计算当前光路状态。
actions.description_en: Calculate the current lightpath state from the inserted and removed limit-switch signals.
